native_probe.control: constant authenticated prone geometry; no learned actor or optimizer

actual_task.guided_path: Learn to fold the physical passive knees near40deg, move wheel support below the whole-robot COM, then coordinate leg extension and wheel velocity to stand in place
actual_task.knee_coordinate: Physical passive included angle: left q_L_joint2 + calibrated model zero; right -q_R_jonit2 + the same zero. Not either active motor encoder angle.
actual_task.excursion_limit_authority: Engineering pilot containment, not a user-approved final in-place recovery limit
actual_task.friction_provenance: Fixed engineering comparison, not identified real tire coefficients
actual_task.body_contact_during_rise: Allowed; native impact impulse, mechanical, spring, closure, numerical and timeout protection retained
actual_task.guidance: Continuous state-based potential shaping only; no scripted targets, timed trajectory, fixed wheel speed, FSM motor takeover, teacher or donor
actual_task.initialization: New actor, new critic, empty Adam; trainable output bias from the declared prone reset geometry
actual_task.randomization: wheel_leg_randomization_study_v2 profiles; retain original ground bands and explicitly record wheel-material hypothesis

evaluation.scope: One standard prone family only; not diverse-fall or full thirteen-capability qualification
